title: Exhaustion by Hermite degree indices
statement: For each natural number $n$, let $I_k$ be the set of multi-indices $\alpha:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb N$ whose total degree is at most $k$. Every finite collection of such multi-indices is contained in $I_k$ for all sufficiently large $k$.
